# `adt table`

ABAP table operations

```bash
adt table [options] [command]
```

**Subcommands**

| Command              | Description                        |
| -------------------- | ---------------------------------- |
| `adt table create`   | Create a new ABAP table            |
| `adt table read`     | Read source code of an ABAP table  |
| `adt table write`    | Write source code to an ABAP table |
| `adt table activate` | Activate one or more ABAP table(s) |
| `adt table delete`   | Delete an ABAP table               |

## `adt table create`

Create a new ABAP table

```bash
adt table create [options] <name> <description> <package>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument        | Description       | Default |
| --------------- | ----------------- | ------- |
| `<name>`        | table name        |         |
| `<description>` | Short description |         |
| `<package>`     | Package name      |         |

**Options**

| Option                     | Description                  | Default |
| -------------------------- | ---------------------------- | ------- |
| `-t, --transport <corrnr>` | Transport request number     |         |
| `--no-error-existing`      | Skip if table already exists | `false` |
| `--json`                   | Output as JSON               |         |

## `adt table read`

Read source code of an ABAP table

```bash
adt table read [options] <name>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description | Default |
| -------- | ----------- | ------- |
| `<name>` | table name  |         |

**Options**

| Option                | Description                                                                                     | Default |
| --------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `--json`              | Output metadata as JSON (no source)                                                             |         |
| `-o, --output <file>` | Write source to &lt;file&gt; in UTF-8 instead of stdout (avoids shell redirect encoding issues) |         |

## `adt table write`

Write source code to an ABAP table

```bash
adt table write [options] <name> [file]
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description                        | Default |
| -------- | ---------------------------------- | ------- |
| `<name>` | table name                         |         |
| `[file]` | Source file path (use - for stdin) | `-`     |

**Options**

| Option                     | Description              | Default |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------ | ------- |
| `-t, --transport <corrnr>` | Transport request number |         |
| `--activate`               | Activate after writing   |         |

## `adt table activate`

Activate one or more ABAP table(s)

```bash
adt table activate [options] <names...>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument     | Description   | Default |
| ------------ | ------------- | ------- |
| `<names...>` | table name(s) |         |

**Options**

| Option   | Description    | Default |
| -------- | -------------- | ------- |
| `--json` | Output as JSON |         |

## `adt table delete`

Delete an ABAP table

```bash
adt table delete [options] <name>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description | Default |
| -------- | ----------- | ------- |
| `<name>` | table name  |         |

**Options**

| Option                     | Description              | Default |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------ | ------- |
| `-t, --transport <corrnr>` | Transport request number |         |
| `-y, --yes`                | Skip confirmation prompt |         |
| `--json`                   | Output as JSON           |         |

Global options (`--sid`, `--config`, `--verbose`, …) are accepted by every command — see the [command reference index](./index.md#global-options).
